verdict.rationale: v0 docs confirm it can connect projects to backend services and third-party integrations (Upstash, Neon, Supabase, AI providers) and can scaffold full-stack apps, implying server-side capability, but there is no explicit mention of payments or email integrations, nor documentation of adding custom server-side functions/API routes as a distinct builder feature. missing for 10: explicit payments/email integration support, dedicated server-side function creation docs, independent confirmation of these integrations working in practice.
